rows.note: Use 踩踏 for the act of heavy trampling, especially when describing people treading on something such as grapes.

example.english: The winemaker used his feet to trample the grapes.
example.traditional: 釀酒師用腳踩踏啲葡萄。
example.jyutping: joeng6 zau2 si1 jung6 goek3 caai2 daap6 di1 pou4 tou4

rows.note: Use 咚咚聲 when the heavy footsteps are being referred to specifically as a thudding sound.

example.english: We heard the trample of heavy footsteps coming from upstairs all night.
example.traditional: 我哋成晚都聽到樓上傳嚟嘅咚咚聲。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 seng4 maan5 dou1 teng1 dou3 lau4 soeng6 cyun4 lai4 ge3 dung1 dung1 sing1
